mentions.name: instalobby
mentions.description: This service provides on-demand, hourly billed game server hosting so players only pay for time they actually play, instead of the standard monthly billing used by other providers. It launches with support for Valheim, with more games planned, and offers $1 in credits to new accounts.
mentions.problem: Every game server hosting provider bills monthly, but most players don't play all the time.
mentions.audience: Game server hosting is offered to gamers who don't play all the time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
On-demand game servers: https://www.instalobby.io/

Basically every game server hosting provider bills monthly, but most players don't play all the time. So I'm building instalobby with a friend to provide to gamers on-demand hourly billed game servers.
